items.title: San José State Football Weekly Press Conference (Air Force)
items.summary: Head Coach Ken Niumatalolo, Offensive Coordinator Craig Stutzmann, and Defensive Coordinator Bojay Filimoeatu preview their game at Air Force on Saturday at 4:00 p.m. (PT) on CBS Sports Network. Please join MW+ for same-day access to press conferences.
